cross_references.label: ERISA Civil Enforcement
cross_references.note: § 1001 declares the policy; § 1132 is the enforcement mechanism that gives it legal force in federal court

cross_references.label: ERISA Fiduciary Duties
cross_references.note: § 1001(b) mandates 'standards of conduct, responsibility, and obligation for fiduciaries'; § 1104 codifies those standards (prudent expert, diversification, loyalty)

cross_references.label: Liability for Breach of Fiduciary Duty
cross_references.note: § 1109 breach liability directly implements the § 1001 mandate for fiduciary standards; damages restore the plan to position it would have occupied absent the breach

cross_references.label: ERISA Preemption
cross_references.note: § 1001's Commerce Clause findings are the constitutional predicate for § 1144's broad preemption of state law related to employee benefit plans

cross_references.label: Minimum Vesting Standards
cross_references.note: § 1001(c) calls for 'vesting the accrued benefits of employees'; § 1053 implements the specific vesting schedules
